title: Aegean Power SA - Real-Time Operations Center

tiles.title: System Status — Right Now
Generation Mix
Active Alerts
Generation by Source — Last 30 Minutes
Mainland Grid Frequency (Hz)
tiles.query:
GridTelemetry
| where grid_id == 'GR-MAIN' and timestamp > ago(30m)
| project timestamp, frequency_hz
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Supply vs Demand — All Zones
tiles.query:
GridTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| summarize Load = round(sum(load_mw), 0), Generation = round(sum(generation_mw), 0) by bin(timestamp, 30s)
| extend Surplus_MW = Generation - Load
| project timestamp, Load, Generation
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Wind Speed by Region (m/s)
tiles.query:
WindTurbineTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| extend region = case(plant_id == 'PP-THR-01', 'Thrace', plant_id == 'PP-TIN-01', 'Tinos', 'Naxos')
| summarize avg_wind = round(avg(wind_speed_ms), 1) by bin(timestamp, 30s), region
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Carbon Intensity (gCO2/kWh)
Vibration Heatmap — All 20 Turbines
tiles.query:
WindTurbineTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| summarize avg_vib = round(avg(vibration_mm_s), 2) by bin(timestamp, 30s), turbine_id
| order by timestamp asc, turbine_id asc

tiles.title: WT-NAX-07 Bearing Degradation — INCIDENT
tiles.query:
WindTurbineTelemetry
| where turbine_id == 'WT-NAX-07' and timestamp > ago(30m)
| project timestamp, Vibration = vibration_mm_s, Temp_C = nacelle_temp_c, Power_MW = power_mw
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: ML Anomaly Detection — Vibration
tiles.query:
WindTurbineTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| make-series avg_vib = avg(vibration_mm_s) on timestamp step 30s by turbine_id
| extend (anomalies, score, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(avg_vib, 1.5)
| mv-expand timestamp to typeof(datetime), avg_vib to typeof(double), anomalies to typeof(int), score to typeof(double), baseline to typeof(double)
| where anomalies != 0
| project timestamp, turbine_id, Vibration = round(avg_vib, 2), Baseline = round(baseline, 2), Score = round(score, 2), Dir = iff(anomalies > 0, 'Spike', 'Dip')
| order by abs(Score) desc | take 20

tiles.title: Capacity Factor by Farm (%)
tiles.query:
WindTurbineTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(10m)
| extend farm = case(plant_id == 'PP-THR-01', 'Thrace (33.6MW)', plant_id == 'PP-TIN-01', 'Tinos (17MW)', 'Naxos (29.4MW)'),
  farm_cap = case(plant_id == 'PP-THR-01', 33.6, plant_id == 'PP-TIN-01', 17.0, 29.4)
| summarize actual_mw = sum(power_mw), cap = max(farm_cap) by bin(timestamp, 30s), farm
| extend CF_pct = round(100.0 * actual_mw / cap, 1)
| project timestamp, farm, CF_pct
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Turbine Performance Ranking — Now
tiles.query:
WindTurbineTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(2m)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, power_mw, wind_speed_ms, vibration_mm_s, nacelle_temp_c) by turbine_id
| extend cap = case(turbine_id startswith 'WT-TIN', 3.4, 4.2)
| extend CF_pct = round(100.0 * power_mw / cap, 0)
| project Turbine = turbine_id, MW = round(power_mw, 2), Wind = round(wind_speed_ms, 1), CF = strcat(tostring(CF_pct), '%'), Vib = round(vibration_mm_s, 1), Temp = round(nacelle_temp_c, 0)
| order by MW desc

tiles.title: Wind Power Curve — Speed vs Output
tiles.query:
WindTurbineTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(10m)
| extend farm = case(plant_id == 'PP-THR-01', 'Thrace', plant_id == 'PP-TIN-01', 'Tinos', 'Naxos')
| project wind_speed_ms, power_mw, farm

tiles.title: Farm Output Comparison (30m)
tiles.query:
WindTurbineTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| extend farm = case(plant_id == 'PP-THR-01', 'Thrace', plant_id == 'PP-TIN-01', 'Tinos', 'Naxos')
| summarize total_mw = round(sum(power_mw), 1) by bin(timestamp, 30s), farm
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Nacelle Temperature by Turbine (30m)
tiles.query:
WindTurbineTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m) and (turbine_id in ('WT-NAX-07', 'WT-THR-01', 'WT-TIN-01', 'WT-NAX-01'))
| project timestamp, turbine_id, nacelle_temp_c
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Wind Power Forecast — Next 5 Min
tiles.query:
WindTurbineTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| summarize MW = round(sum(power_mw), 1) by bin(timestamp, 30s)
| make-series mw = avg(MW) on timestamp step 30s
| extend forecast = series_decompose_forecast(mw, 10)
| mv-expand timestamp to typeof(datetime), mw to typeof(double), forecast to typeof(double)
| project timestamp, Actual = mw, Forecast = round(forecast, 1)
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Solar Status — Right Now
Solar Park Output (30m)
tiles.query:
SolarInverterTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| extend park = iff(plant_id == 'PP-THE-01', 'Thessaly 80MW', 'Crete 60MW')
| summarize total_kw = sum(power_kw) by bin(timestamp, 30s), park
| extend MW = round(total_kw/1000.0, 2)
| project timestamp, park, MW
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Irradiance vs Output — Degradation Check
tiles.query:
SolarInverterTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(10m) and irradiance_wm2 > 50
| extend park = iff(plant_id == 'PP-THE-01', 'Thessaly', 'Crete')
| project irradiance_wm2, power_kw, park

tiles.title: Inverter Efficiency Trend (30m)
tiles.query:
SolarInverterTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m) and irradiance_wm2 > 50
| extend park = iff(plant_id == 'PP-THE-01', 'Thessaly', 'Crete')
| summarize avg_eff = round(avg(efficiency_pct), 1) by bin(timestamp, 1m), park
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Panel Temperature Heatmap
tiles.query:
SolarInverterTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| summarize avg_temp = round(avg(panel_temp_c), 1) by bin(timestamp, 1m), inverter_id
| order by timestamp asc, inverter_id asc

tiles.title: CO2 Emission Rate — Both Plants (30m)
tiles.query:
EmissionsStream
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| project timestamp, Plant = plant_name, tCO2h = round(co2_kg_per_hour/1000.0, 2)
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: ETS Allowance Burn-Down
tiles.query:
EmissionsStream
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| project timestamp, Plant = plant_name, Used_Pct = round(compliance_pct, 1)
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: ETS Compliance Status
tiles.query:
EmissionsStream
| where timestamp > ago(5m)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by plant_id
| project Plant = plant_name, MW = round(power_output_mw, 1), CO2_tph = round(co2_kg_per_hour/1000.0, 2), Today_t = round(cumulative_co2_tonnes_today, 1), Cap_t = round(ets_daily_allowance_tonnes * 1.0, 0), Used_Pct = round(compliance_pct, 1), Status = case(compliance_pct > 95, 'BREACH RISK', compliance_pct > 80, 'Warning', 'OK')
| order by Used_Pct desc

tiles.title: Carbon Intensity Trend (gCO2/kWh)
Grid Status — Right Now
Grid Frequency — All Zones (30m)
tiles.query:
GridTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| project timestamp, grid_name, frequency_hz
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Grid Zone Status
tiles.query:
GridTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(2m)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, frequency_hz, load_mw, generation_mw, balance_mw, voltage_kv) by grid_id, grid_name
| extend Reserve_Pct = iff(load_mw > 0, round(100.0*(generation_mw - load_mw)/load_mw, 1), 0.0)
| extend Status = case(frequency_hz < 49.7 or frequency_hz > 50.3, '🔴 CRITICAL', frequency_hz < 49.85 or frequency_hz > 50.15, '🟡 Warning', '🟢 Normal')
| extend Reason = case(frequency_hz < 49.7, strcat('Freq LOW ', tostring(round(frequency_hz,3)), ' Hz — under-generation risk'), frequency_hz > 50.3, strcat('Freq HIGH ', tostring(round(frequency_hz,3)), ' Hz — over-generation risk'), frequency_hz < 49.85, strcat('Freq dip ', tostring(round(frequency_hz,3)), ' Hz — load slightly exceeds gen'), frequency_hz > 50.15, strcat('Freq rise ', tostring(round(frequency_hz,3)), ' Hz — gen slightly exceeds load'), 'Frequency stable at ', tostring(round(frequency_hz,3)), ' Hz')
| project Grid = grid_name, Hz = round(frequency_hz, 3), Load = round(load_mw, 1), Gen = round(generation_mw, 1), Reserve = strcat(tostring(Reserve_Pct), '%'), kV = round(voltage_kv, 1), Status, Reason
| order by Status asc, Grid asc

tiles.title: Load vs Generation — Mainland (30m)
tiles.query:
GridTelemetry
| where grid_id == 'GR-MAIN' and timestamp > ago(30m)
| project timestamp, Load_MW = load_mw, Generation_MW = generation_mw
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Reserve Margin % — All Zones (30m)
tiles.query:
GridTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| extend reserve_pct = iff(load_mw > 0, round(100.0*(generation_mw - load_mw)/load_mw, 1), 0.0)
| summarize avg_reserve = round(avg(reserve_pct), 1) by bin(timestamp, 30s), grid_name
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Island Frequency Anomalies (ML)
tiles.query:
GridTelemetry
| where grid_id != 'GR-MAIN' and timestamp > ago(30m)
| make-series avg_freq = avg(frequency_hz) on timestamp step 30s by grid_name
| extend (anomalies, score, baseline) = series_decompose_anomalies(avg_freq, 2.0)
| mv-expand timestamp to typeof(datetime), avg_freq to typeof(double), anomalies to typeof(int), score to typeof(double), baseline to typeof(double)
| where anomalies != 0
| project timestamp, Grid = grid_name, Freq = round(avg_freq, 3), Baseline = round(baseline, 3), Score = round(score, 2)
| order by timestamp desc | take 20

tiles.title: Voltage Stability — All Zones (30m)
tiles.query:
GridTelemetry
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| project timestamp, grid_name, voltage_kv
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Island Load Stress — Demand vs Capacity
tiles.query:
GridTelemetry
| where grid_id != 'GR-MAIN' and timestamp > ago(30m)
| summarize Load_MW = round(avg(load_mw), 1), Gen_MW = round(avg(generation_mw), 1) by bin(timestamp, 30s), grid_name
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Aegean Sea — Fleet Tracking
tiles.query:
VesselPositions
| where timestamp > ago(2m)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by vessel_id
| project Name = vessel_name, Category = vessel_type, longitude, latitude

tiles.title: Fleet Status
tiles.query:
VesselPositions
| where timestamp > ago(2m)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by vessel_id
| project Vessel = vessel_name, Type = vessel_type, ['Speed kn'] = round(speed_knots, 1), Heading = round(heading_deg, 0), Dest = destination, ['ETA h'] = round(eta_hours, 1), Cargo = cargo_status
| order by Vessel asc

tiles.title: Vessel Speed Trend (30m)
tiles.query:
VesselPositions
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| project timestamp, vessel_name, speed_knots
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Vessel Heading Track (30m)
tiles.query:
VesselPositions
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| project timestamp, vessel_name, heading_deg
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: ETA Countdown (30m)
tiles.query:
VesselPositions
| where timestamp > ago(30m)
| project timestamp, vessel_name, eta_hours
| order by timestamp asc

tiles.title: Fleet Tracking — Live Positions
tiles.query:
VesselPositions
| where timestamp > ago(2m)
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by vessel_id
| project Vessel = vessel_name, Type = vessel_type, Lat = round(latitude, 3), Lon = round(longitude, 3), Speed_kn = round(speed_knots, 1), Heading = round(heading_deg, 0), Destination = destination, ETA_h = round(eta_hours, 1), Cargo = cargo_status
| order by Vessel asc
